T: Now this is podracing. And this is dinner.
D: Two Jedi find a gifted slave boy on Tatooine while trying to protect a young queen and her planet.
P: Serve the snacks when the podrace starts at Mos Espa.
S: the fruit stall where Anakin buys a pallie for old Jira
Pears and nectarines sliced and fanned on a board with honey, crumbled feta and toasted pistachios.
Lamb pieces marinated in yoghurt, cumin and garlic, threaded onto skewers and grilled hot and fast, with a tahini sauce.

King prawns in an ice-cold tempura batter fried until puffed and bubbly, with a soy, lime and chilli dipping sauce and sesame mayo. Peel and devein 16 green king prawns, leaving the tails on, and score the bellies so they stay straight. Whisk 100g plain flour, 30g cornflour and 200ml ice-cold soda water until just mixed and still lumpy. Dip the prawns and fry at 180C for 2 minutes until puffed and pale gold. Mix 3 tbsp soy, the juice of a lime and a sliced chilli. Mix 3 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tsp sesame oil.
M: Shmi cooking for the Jedi in her small home
Chicken thighs rubbed with harissa and lemon, roasted at 200C on chickpeas and red onion, with flatbread and a cucumber yoghurt.
Theed palace fennel pork with polenta

Pork loin roasted with fennel, garlic and white wine, sliced over soft parmesan polenta with blistered roasted grapes and the pan juices. Rub a 1.2kg pork loin with crushed fennel seeds, 3 garlic cloves, olive oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 50 minutes with 2 sliced fennel bulbs and 150ml white wine in the tray, adding 300g red grapes for the last 15 minutes. Rest 10 minutes. Whisk 200g instant polenta into 1L simmering stock and cook 5 minutes, then stir in 40g butter and 50g parmesan. Slice the pork over the polenta.
W: Duel of the Fates red and blue tart
the double-bladed red lightsaber against the Jedi
Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with vanilla custard, topped half with raspberries and half with blueberries, glazed with jam.
K: Milk blended with coconut milk, a little honey and a few drops of blue colouring, served icy cold.

note.text: Patience, Anakin. The Force is with you, and so is lunch.

winks: Jar Jar Binks in the swamp

steps.text: Slice the pears and nectarines thinly and fan out on a big board.
Drizzle with honey, then scatter with feta and pistachios. Serve straight away.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, grill fresh

steps.text: Marinate the lamb in the yoghurt, cumin, garlic and salt for an hour.
Thread onto skewers and grill hot and fast, turning.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and water until smooth and drizzle over to serve.
Rub the chicken with harissa, lemon juice and salt.
Spread the chickpeas and onions in a tray and sit the chicken on top.
Mix the cucumber into the yoghurt. Warm the flatbreads and serve everything together.

dishes.n: Duel of the Fates red and blue tart

steps.text: Line a tart tin with the pastry and blind bake at 180C until golden. Cool.
Fill with the custard. Cover one half with raspberries and the other half with blueberries, meeting in a clean line.
Brush with warm apricot jam to glaze and chill.
Blend the milk, coconut milk, honey and ice until frothy.
Add a few drops of blue colouring and blend until evenly pale blue. Serve icy cold.

s.note: the fruit stall where Anakin buys a pallie for old Jira
s.how: Slice 2 pears and 3 nectarines thinly and fan out on a big board. Drizzle with honey, then scatter with crumbled feta and roughly chopped toasted pistachios. Serve straight away like a market stall spread in the desert heat.

Cut 600g lamb leg into cubes and marinate in yoghurt, cumin, crushed garlic and salt for an hour. Thread onto skewers and grill hot and fast for 6 minutes, turning. Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water until smooth and drizzle over to serve.

m.note: Shmi cooking for the Jedi in her small home
m.how: Rub 1kg chicken thighs with harissa, lemon juice and salt. Spread 2 cans of drained chickpeas and 2 sliced red onions in a tray and sit the chicken on top. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes. Serve with warm flatbread and cucumber yoghurt.

w.n: Duel of the Fates red and blue tart
w.note: the double-bladed red lightsaber against the Jedi
w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case and cool. Fill with 500ml thick vanilla custard. Cover one half with raspberries and the other half with blueberries, meeting in a clean line down the middle. Brush with warm apricot jam to glaze and chill.

d.how: Blend 750ml cold milk with 250ml coconut milk, 2 tbsp honey and a big handful of ice until frothy. Add a few drops of blue food colouring and blend again until evenly pale blue. Pour into glasses and serve icy cold.
